behavior_change_rationale.8: Make partial reviewer launch recovery explicit: defer capacity-blocked aspects, retry no-handle launches once with the inherited current-session model, then fall back to primary sequential review.
behavior_change_rationale.9: Automatically add a Rubber Duck challenge for substantial reviews and disclose primary-model fallback when no contrasting model is available.
behavior_change_rationale.10: Skip independent challengers for small direct changes unless the user explicitly requests one.
behavior_change_rationale.11: Run SPAR only on explicit request and keep its unresolved challenges separate from ordinary findings.
behavior_change_rationale.12: Honor an explicit request to exclude the automatically applicable Rubber Duck pass.
behavior_change_rationale.13: Preserve cross-model challenge provenance while mapping verified candidates to canonical review aspects.
behavior_change_rationale.14: Infer automatic Rubber Duck applicability from the changed public payment behavior without relying on an explicit substantial label.

clarification_rationale._coverage: The cases cover routing, evidence quality, aggregation, optional security, command execution, and report shape without duplicating every language-specific review example.
